article.title: Google Cloud在合作夥伴行銷平台加入Gemini代理工具
article.summary: Google Cloud公布Partner Marketing Studio更新，把Gemini工具加入合作夥伴的聯合行銷流程。
highlights: 功能包括對話搜尋、品牌審閱、ISV素材生成、社群編輯及客戶案例草擬。
公告亦列出130種語言的輔助翻譯，以及自然語言分析。
article.why: 合作行銷團隊可把Google Cloud聯名規範放進素材製作階段，評估哪些渠道和語言版本可沿用同一工作流程。
article.next_step: 以一項Google Cloud合作方案建立聯名素材，逐項核對品牌審閱建議及各社群渠道改寫內容。
article.detail: Google Cloud的公告把這些能力定位於合作夥伴工作流程。品牌審閱代理協助檢查Google Cloud合作品牌指引，社群編輯則可調整渠道訊息並加入帳戶標籤。團隊可以先用一組已批准的聯名素材作參考，檢查代理的修訂是否仍準確呈現雙方角色及方案內容，再處理多語言版本。
article.title_en: Google Cloud adds Gemini agents to partner marketing workflows
article.summary_en: Google Cloud announced Gemini tools within Partner Marketing Studio for joint marketing by its partners.
highlights_en: Features cover conversational search, brand review, ISV assets, social editing and customer-story drafting.
The announcement also lists assisted translation across 130 languages and natural-language analytics.
article.why_en: Partner marketers can assess joint-brand rules during production and which channels and languages fit one workflow.
article.next_step_en: Build assets for one Google Cloud partner offering and reconcile brand-review suggestions with channel-specific copy.
article.detail_en: Google positions the tools for partner workflows. Its reviewer assists with partner brand guidelines, and the social editor adapts messages and account tags. Use approved joint assets as a reference to check both parties' roles and the offering before preparing translations.
